description: The free, MIT-licensed NetForge Community edition. Installs the `netforge` template: scaffolds an ASP.NET Core 10 app with a choice of React 19 or Angular 22 frontend (`--frontend react|angular`) — auth, RBAC, the platform layer, theming, and i18n, a polished line-of-business starting point. Pro adds webhooks, audit, dashboard, multi-tenancy, notifications, and more (netforge.ebenmonney.com).
title: NetForge — ASP.NET Core 10 + React 19 / Angular 22 starter (MIT)
